summary: Casa Mountain appears only as a name and county on one lookout listing; no other source found confirms a tower, its build date, staffing or condition.

evidence.supports: a lookout named Casa Mountain is listed
the listing places it in Perry County
Arkansas has fourteen lookouts on the National Historic Lookout Register; Casa Mountain is not among the named sites
evidence.quote: Arkansas has fourteen lookouts on the National Historic Lookout Register

notes_for_editor: The only evidence is the listing's name and county. Two web searches and the Encyclopedia of Arkansas and Preserve Arkansas pages named no Casa Mountain tower. The record's coordinates (34.9844, -93.0702) are not verified by any source read. The Encyclopedia has an entry on the Casa community in Perry County; it mentions no lookout or mountain, so the listing may refer to a mountain near that community, which no source confirms. Recommend holding the story.
